a: Paint ignores `region.chromeId`, so a region hidden by chrome-caps is still drawn while it cannot be hit
Annulus paint centers the inner cutout on (cx, cy); hit-test uses innerX/innerY
Escape-returns-to-default bypasses the mode gate that tool keys obey
`useKeyState({ target })` never attaches when the element mounts after the effect, or re-attaches when it changes
b: composeAffordanceLayer draws a region whose `chromeId` is hidden, but its hit-test skips that region
Regions are hit-tested in screen space but ranked by world distance, so non-uniform zoom picks the wrong "nearest" region
The annulus fill assumes the inner rect is centered on `(cx, cy)`, but the hit-test uses `innerX/innerY`
The middle-button pan doesn't pan with a modifier held, or over chrome that claims the press exclusively
